$comment: Foreground/background token pairs checked in every theme by tokens.test.ts (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 / 1.4.11). 'text' needs 4.5:1 and 'ui' needs 3:1. 'redundant' pairs are risk graphics whose meaning is also carried by a shape and a label (doc 13 §1.1, SC 1.4.1), so they only have to stay distinguishable from paper.
